protocol.A: No additional sensory measurement; training-side mean baseline
protocol.T: Fixed actually recorded native.Bitterness field; same source record, not an independent grader/reference
protocol.aggregation: Mean row squared error within held composition group, then equal group mean; report MSE and RMSE on native0–10 units
protocol.configuration_selection: One fixed setting; no response-dependent tuning, exclusions or weights; schema/marginal ranges inspected before split, no earlier model outcomes
protocol.controls: Train-group half versus all; B rotated as whole design-group blocks with matching processing/concentration/multiplicity signatures; singleton strata unchanged
protocol.grouping: All equal four-component proportions coheld across both processing views and all concentrations;16 design groups share a small constituent pool, not16 independent beans
protocol.model: Identical intercept+slope allocation: baseline slope zero; observed-B ridge coefficient penalty0.1; group-normalized half squared error, unpenalized intercept; closed form
protocol.prediction: Clip to known source response range0–10; not a presence probability
protocol.role: Static masked-field prediction, not a product question, calibrated intensity, descriptor presence, cross-grader truth or extra user slot
protocol.scale: Author's native continuous0–10 response; divide by known10, do not fit scaler on held data
protocol.source_license: Author-released Blendstat1.0.6 CRAN GPL-3 with dataset Rd and no separate dataset exception; source and weights private
protocol.split: Sort composition groups by SHA256(R5_BLEND_CONFIRM|group); first4 held for small new-source confirmation, remaining12 deterministic3fold development; no outcome-based selection
protocol.transfer: No numeric score pooled with descriptor logits or primary R5 metrics; no production/trigger use
protocol.unit: Source condition-level row without participant IDs; no reconstruction of the paper's five tasters

auxiliary_new_source_response.scope: Static masked-field prediction, not a product question, calibrated intensity, descriptor presence, cross-grader truth or extra user slot
auxiliary_new_source_response.status_limit: Both fixed development and four reserved design groups improve source-native response RMSE; not independent-coffee generalization, independent-professional-T alignment or product-question value.
